events.text: Gipo Farassino becomes national secretary.

events.label: founding
events.text: Party founded by splinters from Piedmontese Union.

evidence.quote: The party was founded in April 1987 by splinters from Piedmontese Union

events.label: election
events.text: Predecessor PA ran in 1989 European Parliament election within a coalition.

evidence.quote: PA participated in the 1989 European Parliament election as part of the coalition

events.text: Predecessor took part in integration of Northern regionalist parties, 1989-1990.

evidence.quote: In 1989–1990 it took part to the process of integration of the Northern regionalist parties

events.text: Angelo Colli becomes national president.
Predecessor merged into Lega Nord and took the current name.

evidence.quote: in February 1991 , it was merged into Lega Nord , taking the current name

events.text: Angelo Colli's national presidency ends.
Farassino narrowly re-elected national secretary after challenge.

evidence.quote: In 1994 Farassino fended off a challenge by Oreste Rossi and was narrowly re-elected national secretary

events.text: Domenico Comino becomes national president.
Domenico Comino replaces Farassino as national secretary.

evidence.quote: In 1997 Farassino was replaced as secretary by Domenico Comino

events.text: Bernardino Bosio becomes national president, succeeding Comino.
Comino left the party over disputes with Bossi and formed own party.

evidence.quote: In 1999 the party suffered a damaging split when Comino left the party

events.text: Bernardino Bosio becomes national secretary, succeeding Comino.
Bernardino Bosio's national presidency ends.
Silvano Straneo becomes national president.
Party joins regional government coalition led by Enzo Ghigo.

evidence.quote: From 2000 to 2005 the party took part to the regional government led by Enzo Ghigo

events.text: Roberto Cota elected national secretary with mandate to rebuild party.

evidence.quote: In 2001 Cota was elected national secretary of LNP

events.text: Oreste Rossi becomes national president.
Mario Borghezio becomes national president.
Party leaves regional government coalition.

evidence.quote: From 2000 to 2005 the party took part to the regional government

events.text: Cota chosen as joint PdL and Lega Nord candidate for regional president.

evidence.quote: In the run-up of the 2010 regional election , Cota was chosen as joint candidate for President

events.text: Mario Borghezio's national presidency ends.
Gianna Gancia becomes national president.
Stefano Allasia elected national president, succeeding Gancia.

evidence.quote: Subsequently , Stefano Allasia was elected president

events.text: Riccardo Molinari replaces Cota as national secretary.

evidence.quote: In February 2016 , during a hard-fought national congress , Riccardo Molinari replaced Cota as national secretary

undated_mentions: LNP entered the centre-right House of Freedoms coalition (date not stated)
Predecessor Piedmontese Autonomist Movement later renamed Autonomist Piedmont (PA) (date not stated)
